__1 N. of a region abounding in Udumbara trees. 
__2 A form of Yama, the god of death. 
__3 Made of copper. 
__4 A class of ascetics solely living on whatever fruits they see first early in the morning; [[

.]] 
-री A branch of the Udumbara tree. 
-रम् 
__1 The wood of the Udumbara tree. 
__2 The Udumbara fruit. 
__3 A kind of leprosy. 
__4 Copper or a copper-vessel; [[
A place full of Udumbara trees.
